import bisect

def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    t = int(input())
    
    a.sort()
    
    maxCount = 0
    for i in range(n):
        upperBound = a[i] + t
        # Find the first index where element > upperBound
        it = bisect.bisect_right(a, upperBound, lo=i)
        count = it - i
        if count > maxCount:
            maxCount = count
    
    print(maxCount)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
